name: Te Amo: A Crystal Dream
source:
One ordinary day, the life of a young career woman turns upside down. To set things right, she'll have to find those who were left behind in a distant past.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Te_Amo]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
一个平凡的一天，一位年轻职业女性的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。为了扭转局面，她必须找到那些在遥远的过去被遗忘的人。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Te_Amo]romance-club.fandom[/url]
